children: Colombia’s Producer Price Index rose 2.20% year over year in September 2026, accelerating from a 0.76% increase in August. Mining and quarrying (6.38%) and agriculture, livestock, forestry, hunting and fishing (4.57%) recorded increases above the 2.20% average, while manufacturing rose 0.52%.
The largest price increases were recorded for potatoes (155.92%), citrus fruits (34.58%) and crude petroleum oils and oils obtained from bituminous minerals (10.42%).
In contrast, the main deflationary pressures came from coffee (-32.36%), milled or green coffee (-19.33%) and ethyl alcohol and other alcohols, denatured alcohols of any concentration (-27.51%).

title: Colombia PPI Growth Accelerates in September
